title: 48 Samples to MCT Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as follows: Slot 1 – custom 5 mL tube rack with samples 1‑24; Slot 2 – Opentrons acrylic tube rack for samples 1‑24; Slot 4 – custom 5 mL tube rack with samples 25‑48; Slot 5 – Opentrons acrylic tube rack for samples 25‑48; Slot 7 – Opentrons 300 µL pipette tip rack.

steps.title: Load protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol from the provided link and upload it into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate the custom tube racks, acrylic tube racks, tip rack, and the P300 single‑channel GEN1 pipette (using calibration tips as described in the support article).

steps.title: Execute the transfer
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App; the robot will use the P300 single‑channel pipette to transfer 100 µL from each source tube in the custom 5 mL rack to the corresponding destination tube in the acrylic tube rack.
